label: Kestrel Ledger — Webhook retry incident (INC-2291)
description: Backend engineering incident: after release 2.14 the outbound webhook dispatcher retries permanent 4xx responses (hammering a merchant's 410 endpoint) and creates a second delivery when the at-least-once event bus republishes an event (a merchant shipped an order twice). The candidate fixes both in a small Python service, adapts to a mid-session Retry-After requirement, and writes a reviewer handoff.
